description:
pkix-ct/src/verify.rs:568-603

`SignedTreeHead` (6 public fields) and `MerkleAuditPath` (3 public
fields) are both public struct-with-all-public-fields types missing
`#[non_exhaustive]`.

For `SignedTreeHead`, the wire-format binding is now permanent:

- Cannot add `log_id: [u8; 32]` (which would make `verify_sth` not
  need to take it separately, fixing the redundancy in
  PKIX-ppbr.16).
- Cannot change `signature: Vec<u8>` to a typed signature.
- Cannot drop `hash_alg`/`sig_alg` as separate fields if the algorithm
  becomes implicit in a future RFC 9162 v2 variant.

For `MerkleAuditPath`:

- Cannot add a `proof_source: Option<String>` (CT log this proof
  came from, for diagnostics).
- Cannot change `audit_path: Vec<[u8; 32]>` to a `Vec<NodeHash>`
  newtype.
- Constructible with arbitrary `leaf_index > tree_size` or
  garbage audit_path — see PKIX-ppbr.21 (defensive label) for the
  invariant-bypass angle.

Recommendation: `#[non_exhaustive]` on both. Per non-negotiable #6
they stay clone/debug/eq/hash. Public-field access via `.audit_path`
is fine; what `#[non_exhaustive]` blocks is exhaustive struct
literals, which is what locks the maintainer in.
title: SignedTreeHead and MerkleAuditPath lack #[non_exhaustive], all wire fields public
